en.answer:
Yes, the Token will contribute 2000 ATK/DEF.

The Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF listed in the effect that Special Summons a Monster Token are treated as that Token's original Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF. Therefore, if an Adventurer Token that was Special Summoned by <<16748>> is Tributed, its original ATK and DEF is 2000, and these values will be included in the Primal Being Token's ATK/DEF.
en.question: If the effect of <<14741>> Tributes monsters, including an Adventurer Token, will the ATK/DEF (both 2000) of the Adventurer Token be included in the ATK/DEF of the Primal Being Token?
en.title: If I Tribute a Token using <<14741>>'s effect, what impact does this have on the Primal Being Token's ATK/DEF?
